expectations.text: Output contains a Markdown table with columns for Task, Component, Size, Depends On, and Acceptance Criteria
expectations.evidence: Output uses prose sections (Phase 1–9). The final 'Task Summary Table' only has columns #, Phase, Deliverable, Owner — no Size, Depends On, or Acceptance Criteria

expectations.text: At least one task explicitly covers creating a database migration or new notifications table
expectations.evidence: Phase 1, Section 1.2: 'EF Core Migration — Add DbSet<Notification> Notifications to AppDbContext, Generate migration: dotnet ef migrations add AddNotificationsTable'

expectations.text: The risk assessment flags the database migration as a risk
expectations.evidence: No risk assessment section in the output. The output covers architecture decisions, phases, and a future enhancements table, but no risk/mitigation analysis

expectations.text: At least one task covers a frontend bell icon, badge, or notification panel component
expectations.evidence: Phase 8.2 describes NotificationBell with bell icon, red badge with unread count, and toggle behavior

expectations.text: A mark-as-read endpoint or service method is represented as a distinct task
expectations.evidence: Phase 4 controller table includes 'PATCH v1/notifications/{id}/read — Mark single notification as read' and 'PATCH v1/notifications/read-all'

expectations.text: Total number of tasks in the table is 8 or more
expectations.evidence: Task Summary Table at the bottom has 13 rows (#1–#13)
